features.description: Natural logarithm of volume per atom, capturing structural dilution and unusually open cells.
features.name: log_volume_per_atom

features.description: Composition-averaged covalent sphere volume divided by actual atomic volume; missing radii are excluded and remaining fractions renormalized.
features.name: covalent_packing_fraction

features.description: Valence electrons per cubic angstrom, using the supplied valence convention and renormalizing over available elemental values.
features.name: valence_electron_density

features.description: Composition-weighted Mulliken electronegativity spread divided by atomic hardness, centered using inverse-hardness weights.
features.name: hardness_weighted_electronegativity_spread
